releaseNotes: New Ophelia brand app icon — the official Clone by Ophelia mark
Products tab: install Deadlock Studio's other apps, starting with Pic Hider (private photo & video vault)
System apps (Play Store, Gallery…) are now dimmed and blocked with a clear reason instead of failing at install
Curated apps that aren't installed get an "install app" tile that opens their Play Store page in one tap
Clones show a bold glowing "Developed by Deadlock Studio" credit on their loading screen (removable only under Advanced)
App source can't be cloned anymore only when it truly can't (sharedUserId apps are rejected up front with a clear message)
